query: WITH page_scope AS (SELECT source_page FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 504 AND 508), fact_scope AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 504 AND 508), note_scope AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 504 AND 508), mcq_scope AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 504 AND 508) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM page_scope) AS source_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_scope) AS facts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note_scope) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcq_scope) AS mcqs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN mcq_scope m ON m.id = o.mcq_id) AS mcq_options, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_sources s JOIN mcq_scope m ON m.id = s.mcq_id) AS mcq_sources, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0504-0508:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type = 'fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM fact_scope)) OR (d.entity_type = 'note' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM note_scope)) OR (d.entity_type = 'mcq' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM mcq_scope))) AS search_documents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 504 AND 508) AS verifications, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN mcq_scope m ON a.entity_type = 'mcq' AND a.entity_id = m.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN fact_scope f ON a.entity_type = 'fact' AND a.entity_id = f.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN note_scope n ON a.entity_type = 'note' AND a.entity_id = n.id) AS tag_assignments LIMIT 1;
